data.title: Fifa denies embattled chief sought Trump’s help
data.description: Fifa on Tuesday dismissed ‌as “pure fiction” a report that its president Gianni Infantino had sought support from US President Donald Trump’s administration after the collapse of a plan to sell a stake in World Cup commercial rights.

data.title: ONE Championship: Abdallah Ondash tells Prajanchai ‘you are next’ after 19-second KO
data.description: Abdallah Ondash has told undisputed strawweight Muay Thai champion Prajanchai PK Saenchai “you are next” after delivering a 19-second knockout that strengthened his claim for a ONE Championship title opportunity.

data.title: Thailand's spikers reign, sweep Vietnam
data.description: The Thai women's volleyball team put on a strong performance in the championship decider of 2026 SEA V Cup first leg, decisively defeating hosts Vietnam 3-0 (25-18, 25-17, 25-14) in Hanoi on Sunday night.

data.title: ONE Championship: Islay Bomogao asks Chatri for 105lb division after earning US$100,000 contract
data.description: Islay Erika Bomogao has asked ONE Championship chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong to create a new 105lb division after earning a US$100,000 contract in Bangkok.

data.title: Infantino, the FIFA president under pressure after scrapped investor plan
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino's ability to brush aside criticism and push through enlarged versions of the Club World Cup and World Cup lent him an air of omnipotence, but a failed private investor plan has left his position under threat for the first time.

data.title: Atiruj ends long wait with Pattaya triumph
data.description: Atiruj Winaicharoenchai finally claimed the title he had coveted for nearly a decade, edging home by a single stroke to win the Singha Pattaya Open at Laem Chabang International Country Club on Sunday.

data.title: Villa roll into city to play BG
data.description: Fresh from their Europa League triumph, Aston Villa continue their Asian pre‑season tour tonight with a meeting against Thai Premier League side BG Pathum United at True BG Stadium.

data.title: Kingdom's spikers reign, sweep Vietnam

data.title: Hudson demands ruthless display
data.description: Thailand will look to maintain their perfect start to the Asean Hyundai Cup when they face hosts, the Philippines, in New Clark City tonight, with head coach Anthony Hudson insisting his side must keep their concentration despite back‑to‑back victories that have already underlined their credentials.

data.title: ONE Championship: Aliff backed for Malaysia homecoming after historic Anwar meeting
data.description: Aliff Sor Dechapan’s historic title triumph has taken him to the Malaysian Prime Minister’s Office – and growing calls for the country’s first ONE Championship world champion to fight on home soil could help shape what comes next.

data.title: Fifa's Infantino sought Trump backing after failed World Cup sell-off plan
data.description: LONDON — Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) President ⁠Gianni ⁠Infantino sought support ​from the Donald Trump administration amid mounting criticism after ​his abandoned plan to sell a stake in World Cup commercial rights, the New York Post said on Monday, citing sources familiar with the matter.

data.title: Commonwealth Games faces uncertain future ahead of centenary edition
data.description: GLASGOW - Glasgow stepped in to save the 2026 Commonwealth Games, but a slimmed down 10-sport model over the last 10 days has failed to dispel doubts over the future of the event.

data.title: Record riders for school c'ship
data.description: The Thailand Equestrian Federation under the Royal Patronage, in collaboration with the Department of Physical Education (DPE), is set to host the 2026 Equestrian Inter-School Championship, to be held from Aug 12-16 at the B.Grimm Country Club, known as Thai Polo & Equestrian Club, in Pattaya.

data.title: Hudson hails gritty War Elephants
data.description: Thailand coach Anthony Hudson hailed his team's performance after the War Elephants defeated Malaysia 2-0 to move into pole position in Group B of the Asean Hyundai Cup at Rajamangala National Stadium on Saturday night.

data.title: Japan's Kuwaki wins women's British Open to clinch first major title
data.description: LYTHAM ST ANNES (UNITED KINGDOM) - Japan's Shiho Kuwaki won the women's British Open in a dramatic play-off with Esther Henseleit on Sunday, securing her first major title in memorable style.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ramadan Ondash rejects Ghazali rematch, tells Aliff ‘come to flyweight’
data.description: Ramadan Ondash has rejected an immediate rematch with Johan Ghazali and told former conqueror Aliff Sor Dechapan to follow him to flyweight as he targets ONE Championship gold – preferably in Qatar.

data.title: ONE Championship: Johan Ghazali wants Ondash rematch ‘today’ – and tells rival to buy new mouthguard
data.description: Johan Ghazali has called for an immediate rematch with Ramadan Ondash in ONE Championship – and told his rival to invest in a better mouthguard before they meet again.

data.title: Jude's new Port of call as forward eyes trophies
data.description: Thai-English forward Jude Soonsup-Bell said he believes in Port's potential after joining the Thai League 1 giants from English league.

data.title: European football chiefs lose ‘confidence’ in Fifa boss
data.description: PARIS - Fifa president Gianni Infantino has lost the “confidence” of European football’s governing body after his plan to allow private investment in the World Cup was withdrawn following a global backlash.

data.title: Fifa scraps share-sale plan after fierce backlash
data.description: Fifa’s plan ⁠to ⁠sell a piece of ​its business empire to outside investors has collapsed following an open ​revolt by football officials worldwide and ‌a major rift among top Fifa executives.

data.title: RSY Philippines land IYBC top honours
data.description: The Philippines' RSY Group of Companies claimed the U18 boys diamond division championship at the International Youth Basketball Championships 2026 (IYBC 2026), defeating Mongolia's Modun Wolves 85–72 in a thrilling final to lift the prestigious Royal Trophy, graciously bestowed by Her Royal Highness Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn.

data.title: Supanida, mixed pairs suffer exits
data.description: Supanida Katethong bowed out in the quarter-finals of the women's singles event at the US$250,000 (approx 8.4 million baht) BWF Taipei Open yesterday.

data.title: Keegan a player with immense pride and passion
data.description: It was sad to learn of the recent death of Kevin Keegan, a charismatic footballer I greatly admired. I was fortunate enough to be amongst the packed crowd at St James' Park to see Keegan in one of his last games as a player in May 1984. Newcastle were seeking promotion from the Second Division and a win over Derby would just about clinch it. It turned out to be a memorable occasion.

data.title: War Elephants face acid test
data.description: Seven-times champions Thailand will take on arch-rivals Malaysia in an Asean Hyundai Cup Group B fixture at Bangkok's Rajamangala Stadium on Saturday night, in what promises to be one of the standout ties of the group phase.

data.title: Fifa vows to go ahead with private investor proposal
data.description: PARIS — World football's governing bodyFédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) vowed on Friday to press ahead with an "open and democratic" consultation on a proposed private investment plan despite widespread opposition to the proposal.

data.title: Ferrand-Prevot bids to defend Tour de France Femmes title
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Pauline Ferrand-Prevot begins the Tour de France Femmes this weekend determined to repeat last year's triumph, but the Frenchwoman faces a tough challenge in a field headed by in-form Dutch rival Demi Vollering.

data.title: Field of 10 confirmed in SAT chief race
data.description: The Sports Authority of Thailand (SAT) has closed applications for the position of Governor, with the field settling at 10 candidates after Dr Mallika Boonmeetrakul Mahasuk submitted her application on the final day.
